esign.title: E-signature
esign.notEnabled: E-signature is off for your company ({{path:sign}}).
esign.notReady: Cannot be sent for signing yet: the contract must be approved and have a PDF file. If the current file is not a PDF, ask its creator to upload a PDF.
esign.demoHint: Test signing is on. Turn on DocuSign or an e-signature provider in Settings for legal effect.
esign.cancelWarn: Signers will no longer be able to sign. To sign again the contract must be re-sent.
esign.name: Full name
esign.dialogHint: Signers sign one after another. Internal signers sign in the app; the partner receives an email from the e-signature provider.
esign.settingHint: Allow sending approved contracts for e-signature.
esign.settingOwnerOnly: Only the Contracts owner (Full access group) can switch this on or off. Ask them to open {{path:sign}}.
esign.inviteThumb: Include the first-page image in signing invitation emails
esign.inviteThumbHint: Signing invitations always carry a contract summary card; turn this on to add the first-page image (the contract itself is never attached).

upload.title: Upload the signed copy
upload.hint: Already signed elsewhere? Upload the signed copy (PDF, JPG or PNG) — the Sign contract step will complete.
upload.override: You are approving on behalf of the assigned signer.

err.FILE_TYPE: This format is not accepted — only PDF, JPG or PNG.
err.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large, choose a smaller one.
err.SIGN_UPLOAD_NOT_AWAITING: The Sign contract step is no longer waiting for a signed copy (someone already handled it). Reload to see.
err.PACK_FORBIDDEN: This signing step is not assigned to you, so you cannot upload.
err.unknown: Could not upload, try again later.

err.ESIGN_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: This e-signature provider is unavailable, choose another one.
err.ESIGN_RESEND_FAILED: Re-sending the envelope failed — press Sign now to try again.
err.ESIGN_SIGNER_NO_EMAIL: Your account has no email, so you cannot be a signer.
err.ESIGN_NOT_SIGNER: Only the company signer of this envelope can sign now.
err.ESIGN_NOT_YOUR_TURN: It is not your turn to sign yet — wait for the signer before you to finish.
err.ESIGN_DISABLED: E-signature is off or not configured.
err.ESIGN_STATE: The contract state does not allow this action.
err.ESIGN_UNSUPPORTED_FILE: Only PDF files can be signed (DOCX/images not supported yet).
err.ESIGN_PROVIDER: The e-signature provider did not respond, try again later.
err.unknown: Could not complete, try again later.
